releaseTitle: ATalk v3.15.0 — Complete UI Overhaul: Structure, Simplification & De-duplication
releaseNotes:
• 01 Comprehensive Text Simplification: Purged all developer jargon, cryptographic acronyms, and technical terms across the entire app (e.g. replaced 'E2EE' with 'End-to-end encrypted' or 'Private', 'Zeroize' with 'Clean', 'Telemetry' with 'Audio Mode', 'Vault Safe' with 'Hidden Safe', 'Cryptographic Constellation Fingerprint' with 'Security Verification Pattern').
• 02 Eliminated Settings Redundancy & Duplicacy: Streamlined ProfileScreen to focus on identity and contact details with clean navigation shortcuts, eliminating duplicated hex keys, independent phone/email sheets, and redundant Log Out / Delete Account dialogs. Removed duplicate disguise radio pickers from StealthSettingsScreen in favor of a direct link to the full Notification Settings studio. Removed redundant notification toggles from PrivacySettingsScreen.
• 03 Enhanced Navigation & Screen Structure: Reorganized settings hierarchies into logical, cohesive sections (Identity, App Settings, Account Security, and Sign Out). Every screen now has consistent padding, clear visual hierarchy, and intuitive grouped cards.
• 04 Real-Time Delivery & Read Receipts: Verified and streamlined single grey tick (Sent), double grey tick (Delivered), and double cyan tick (Read) instant transitions via Supabase Realtime across chats and messages.
• 05 Storage & Data Usage Overhaul: Cleaned up StorageUsageScreen with crystal-clear plain-language storage categories, temporary cache cleaning, and friendly retention policies ('Delete when leaving app', 'Keep forever').
